propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES as a frozenset with three values (Resolved, Done, Cancelled) while DC reads resolved_statuses from configuration, creating parity gap and blocking custom workflow support.
Issues with non-standard resolved-status names (e.g. Closed, Complete) are misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED when the probe should consult configured names.
JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses as a configurable list[str] with built-in coercion from [tool.rebar.jira] block and REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override.
The probe's classify_probe_response must resolve the status set from loaded config at runtime, falling back to module-level default when config is unset, empty, or malformed.
Custom resolved_statuses override the default set entirely; an issue matching a configured name classifies as PRESENT_RESOLVED while unmatched issues classify as PRESENT_FILTERED.
Unset or empty configuration should preserve backward compatibility by falling back to the module-level default rather than binding an empty set.
